name: VoiceRay
summary: Ray-based selection enhanced with ordinal voice commands to resolve ambiguity.
howItWorks: Aim at a cluster, then say an ordinal command such as “third”.
advantages: Dense and clustered distant objects where raycasting is ambiguous.
limitations: Speech latency and social or contextual appropriateness can matter.
